hero.title: File:Invasion of France in 1815.jpg
hero.artist: William Siborne and  engraved by J. Kirkwood in Dublin
hero.credit:
The atlas published to accompany William Siborne's 'History of the War with France and Belgium in 1815

This is a copy of Plate XI from an Anaglyptographic atlas of the Waterloo Campaign probably published in the year 1844 (see Rare atlas detailing the Waterloo Campaign). A smaller version of this map is available on page 626 of William Siborne's, The Waterloo Campaign, 1815 (4th ed., Westminster: A. Constable, 1848)
hero.description: A portion of northern and eastern France and the colour coded lines of advance of five different Seventh Coalition armies.
